text: XX/XX/year>, I received an email from XXXX which is some kind of financial bank business that stated that I was not approved for a loan that I applied for. The email had information pertaining to my credit that was not true. I did not apply for an equity line of credit loan from this company. I called them to inform them about this email and they attempted to get additional personal information from me to inquire about the loan. I explained again that I did not apply for a loan and will not provide my social security and date of birth. They would not give me any information to report this as a fraud through their company. they just aggressively tried to get more personal information to process an inquiry. I am attaching the email as documentation which seems to be a phishing scam to get the recipient to give additional information and run an inquiry on your credit. I checked my credit report to be sure and there were no inquiries from XXXX.

meta.issue: Applying for a mortgage or refinancing an existing mortgage
